issues.t: secretsmanager: 5 net-new causes — CloudFormation stack delete only schedules the secret, {{resolve:secretsmanager:...}} is stored literally, ReplicaRegions stacks end DELETE_FAILED, AWS::SecretsManager::ResourcePolicy a

secretsmanager: 5 net-new causes — a deferred (RotateImmediately=false) rotation never test-invokes the function, RotateSecret after CancelRotateSecret still refuses the stuck rotation, and three refusal messages diverge
secretsmanager: ListSecrets `description` / `all` filter matching never converges on the documented secret set — the check hangs to the 60 s cap (1 cause)

secretsmanager: 2 net-new root causes — BatchGetSecretValue never evaluates a secret's resource policy per entry (denied plaintext returned), and aws:PrincipalArn is never published so a conditioned resource-policy Deny
secretsmanager: a scheduled-but-unfired rotation never runs and CancelRotateSecret leaves no observable state, so both cancel-rotation checks hang to the harness cap
Secrets Manager version-selector, pending-deletion and rotation-metadata responses diverge (6 causes)
Secrets Manager authorization over-refuses: conditioned identity grants and resource-policy Allows never admit a caller AWS permits (3 causes)
PutResourcePolicy refuses a wildcard-principal policy scoped by aws:PrincipalAccount as public, so a non-public resource policy cannot be attached under BlockPublicPolicy=True
REOPENS: UpdateSecret(KmsKeyId=...) does not re-encrypt the secret's labelled versions, so GetSecretValue is refused DecryptionFailure once the OLD key is disabled (1 cause)
CreateSecret relays every KMS envelope refusal as EncryptionFailure instead of the class AWS picks for the key's failure kind (2 causes)
VersionIdsToStages labels a server-minted token-less version AWSCURRENT so DescribeSecret demotes the caller's own version
Secrets Manager DescribeSecret demotes the caller's own AWSCURRENT version to AWSPREVIOUS
Secrets Manager secret-version staging bookkeeping puts AWSCURRENT on a server-minted version, demoting the caller's own version to AWSPREVIOUS (1 cause)
DescribeSecret reports the caller's own ClientRequestToken version as AWSPREVIOUS instead of AWSCURRENT
secretsmanager: RotateSecret after RestoreSecret is accepted but never rotates — AWSCURRENT never moves off the pre-rotation version, so the restore-then-rotate path hangs (1 cause)
Secrets Manager refusal identity and wording diverge on RotateSecret, StopReplicationToReplica and UpdateSecretVersionStage, and one rotation refusal is never raised (4 causes)
Secrets Manager GetResourcePolicy echoes the attached policy document verbatim instead of returning AWS's canonical re-serialization (1 cause)
Secrets Manager accepts CreateSecret, PutSecretValue and UpdateSecret with no ClientRequestToken and mints a version id instead of refusing (5 causes)
Secrets Manager: KmsKeyId is never validated against KMS on CreateSecret/UpdateSecret, and three refusal messages diverge from AWS's wording (4 causes)
Secrets Manager UpdateSecretVersionStage: a stale RemoveFromVersionId is refused with InvalidRequestException and the wrong message instead of InvalidParameterException (1 cause)
Secrets Manager rotation schedule metadata: DescribeSecret omits NextRotationDate for every cron() ScheduleExpression, and never recomputes it from a completed rotation (2 causes)
secretsmanager: RotateSecret(RotateImmediately=true) never runs the rotation function, so AWSCURRENT never moves to a new version and the old version is never demoted to AWSPREVIOUS (1 cause)

secretsmanager: RotateSecret with RotateImmediately=true never executes the rotation function, so no AWSPENDING candidate is staged and the in-flight-rotation guard never refuses a second RotateSecret (1 cause)

Secrets Manager UpdateSecret/UpdateSecretVersionStage: AWSPENDING is not evicted on a new current version, a KmsKeyId change is metadata-only (KMS never consulted), and AWSCURRENT can be removed outright (3 causes)
Secrets Manager BatchGetSecretValue: request-form refusal text/rules diverge and the operation performs no authorization, so denied secrets are returned as plaintext (3 causes)
Secrets Manager: ValidateResourcePolicy's BlockPublicPolicyCheck ValidationErrors entry carries emulator prose instead of the service's fixed ErrorMessage
StopReplicationToReplica on a primary/standalone secret returns an emulator-authored InvalidParameterException message

Secrets Manager DeleteSecret: DescribeSecret.DeletedDate is stamped with the future deletion instant (window offset collapses to zero), and identity-policy Denies over the DeleteSecret request-parameter condition keys ar
Secrets Manager: BatchGetSecretValue, UpdateSecretVersionStage, UpdateSecret and RestoreSecret answer 501 NotImplemented, so staging-label, update and restore behaviour is unreachable (4 causes)

Secrets Manager: resource-based policies and the BlockPublicPolicy condition key are never evaluated, replica writes are accepted, CFN secrets are absent, rotation setup breaks on a bad Lambda ARN, and PutResourcePolicy
